description: This is a Java unit test class for the FileBasedAuthenticationService in the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.impl package. It contains test cases verifying various behaviors such as credential verification, token issuance, permission loading, and authority checks for the authentication service implementation.

classes.name: FileBasedAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of FileBasedAuthenticationService.

methods.name: loadPermissions
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by mocking dependencies and loading permissions from a JSON file into the authentication service.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainFailsForMissingUsername
methods.description: Test case ensuring verification fails when username is null.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainFailsForMissingPassword
methods.description: Test case ensuring verification fails when password is null.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainSucceedsForMatchingPassword
methods.description: Test case verifying successful token issuance when correct credentials are provided.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainGrantsAuthorizationId
methods.description: Verifies that the authorization ID is granted when credentials are correct.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainRefusesAuthorizationId
methods.description: Checks that the user can be authorized to a different identity when permitted.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainRefusesNonExistingAuthorizationId
methods.description: Ensures that the system correctly handles non-existing authorization identities.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalFailsForMissingSubjectDn
methods.description: Verifies that external verification fails without a subject DN.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalGrantsCommonName
methods.description: Tests successful token issuance from external credential verification.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalGrantsAuthorizationId
methods.description: Checks correct authorization ID grant with external verification.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalRefusesNonExistingAuthorizationId
methods.description: Verifies proper handling of non-existing external authorization identities.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalRefusesAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test case ensuring authorization limit is respected for external credentials.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainAddsAuthoritiesForOperations
methods.description: Verifies that the token contains correct authorities for operation execution.
